sections.title: Unit 21: Labor Economics, Technological Displacement & Collective Bargaining
body: The transformation of labor in Central Europe is marked by severe structural tensions: the legacy of industrial proletarianization, the vulnerability of unskilled workers, the erosion of strike rights, and the rise of digital and automated production.

In this unit, anchored by Nagy Lajos's merciless 1934 sociographical investigation 'Kiskunhalom', you will master the elevated academic register used to analyze labor precarity, institutional impersonals, wage disparities, and collective bargaining rights at the C1 level.
